name: quantum flux parametron (QFP) latch
question: Does ramping the latch flux of the QFP (barrier from zero) write the state chosen by the qubit flux, and with which law?
assumptions: U = -(Phi0 Ic/2pi) cos(pi f) cos(phi) + (Phi - Phi_x)^2/2L (Berkley 2010 eq. 3) with phi = th; for f in (1/2, 1] the symmetric double well is at zero main-loop flux
overdamped latch (damping 2); D = gam kT/U with T = 47 mK, U/k_B ~ 121 K (L = 65 pH)
